observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: An outdoor or covered performance space at night, decorated with marigold garlands and colorful drapes, with a seated audience watching in the background.
observation.dancers: Two men performing together in costume.
observation.formation_and_space: One man kneels or crouches on the ground playing a drum while the other stands directly behind and above him, moving in place.
observation.posture: The front dancer is crouched low on one knee with torso upright, while the standing dancer has an upright posture with arms extended.
observation.footwork: The front dancer shifts weight while kneeling/crouching; foot steps are mostly hidden by costume and posture.
observation.arms_and_hands: The front dancer holds and plays a small two-headed drum (damru/dakki) with both hands, striking it rhythmically. The standing dancer holds his arms forward and grips the shoulders or upper body of the front dancer.
observation.hips_and_torso: The front dancer sways and bends the upper torso slightly to the beat of the drum.
observation.partnering: The standing dancer rests his hands on the front dancer's shoulders/head area, creating a close physical connection.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low level (crouching/kneeling) combined with standing level; no jumps or turns visible.
observation.costume_and_props: Traditional cultural attire with metallic and yellow/red garments, crowns, necklaces, and armbands; the front dancer holds a small hourglass drum (dakki).
observation.cannot_infer: Footwork and leg movements are largely obscured by the costume and low camera angle.

signature_moments.what: The kneeling performer rapidly beats a small hourglass drum while the standing performer behind him sways his upper body.
